title: Fully integrated hybrid multimode–multiwavelength photonic processor
core_idea: Design a scalable, monolithically integrated hybrid photonic processor that simultaneously leverages mode-division and wavelength-division multiplexing and incorporates adiabatic mode multiplexers, mode-selective microring resonators, and balanced multimode photodetectors on a single chip to perform analog optical processing for high-speed MIMO and RF signal tasks, reducing dependence on electronic DSP and addressing integration and footprint challenges.
tldr: A single-chip, hybrid photonic processor combining mode- and wavelength-division multiplexing and integrated multimode components to enable scalable analog optical processing for high-throughput MIMO and RF communications.
